task.prompt: Original sci-fi pulse rifle for Siphon, a fast aerial team shooter. Single isolated hard-surface weapon, compact squared receiver, broad wedge barrel shroud, clearly visible circular emitter muzzle, open trigger guard, sturdy pistol grip, short shoulder stock, shallow top sight and inset energy-cell housing. Bold readable silhouette, restrained industrial field equipment, large clean surfaces and a few recessed panel seams. No hands, character, ammunition, background, floating pieces, text, logos or recognizable franchise features. Geometry only; neutral untextured model. Visual replacement only: preserve existing weapon balance, firing origin, collider and gameplay dimensions during later Unity fitting.
